replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states role attribute from assertion grants admin; forged assertion attack is concrete and supported."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack and harm as T1: unverified assertion signature yields admin/arbitrary identity login.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly notes internet-reachable internal admin portal; exposure-based attack path on login endpoints is supported."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: unsolicited/uncorrelated SAML response causing session fixation or login CSRF in SSO flow."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Portal parses attacker-supplied SAML XML from internet; XXE file/internal-service disclosure is concrete."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Quotes mention no RelayState or post-login redirect handling; component absent from design evidence."}]}
